published_ranges._notes: TDS 5.4 covers versions A and B; fields, bed, speed and thermal data are version A. Version B per the same TDS: density 1.22 g/cm3, bed 30-60 C, print speed 50-200 mm/s, Tg 62 C, Vicat 63 C, HDT 0.45 MPa 59 C / 1.8 MPa 58 C; nozzle, retraction and drying identical. Cosplay PLA tuned for sanding/painting. Build surface PC and textured PEI; cooling fan ON. Version A HDT 1.8 MPa 56 C. Diameter not stated on TDS.
